newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on ING Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on ING Q1 results.

text.p: Dutch bank-insurer ING Groep on Thursday reported a rise in net profits of 21 percent to 891 million guilders for the first quarter of 1997. But the company declined to give a firm forecast for the full year.
Below are a collection of analysts' comments:

"The figures are even better than they look at first sight as the company has made a big provision for new techology, reorganisation costs, the euro and the millennium. The banking sector has set aside 160 million guilders and the insurance sector 40 million. You get a completely different picture if you take the provisions into account. For the full-year, I foresee profit growth between 15 and 20 percent. If the banking sector keeps growing at the current pace, the profit rise could be close to 20 percent. All sectors are doing well, except car insurance in Canada."

"Despite the charge of 200 million guilders (provisions for the euro etc.), ING managed to show a net profit of 891 million guilders for the first quarter. Net profits in the first quarter would have been some 70 million guilders higher without the provision. This means the profit is at the top of the range. The question is how big the provisions for the full-year are going to be. But, looking at the first-quarter results, the full-year results are probably going to be better than the 16 percent increase to 3.8 billion guilders I had previously forecast."
BART VAN DER FEEN DE LILLE, IRIS RESEARCH:

"These figures are very nice; earnings per share were exactly as we had expected, and the quality of the results is very good. The figure includes 200 million guilders of provisions. ING Barings and Barings Asset Management stand out, it looks af if Barings starts to do really well. We expect Barings to perform well in the second quarter as well.
Taking into account the 160 million guilders of provisions, banking did really good business. Corrected for 40 million in insurance, results in that sector are neat as well.
These results are no reason to change our Strong Buy opinion on the stock, we keep our forecast of e.p.s. at 5.10 guilders per share for this year."
